experiment_title: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: GSM1636933: MCF7_Pol2_N20_ChIP_A Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
study_title: RNA Polymerase II Pausing Can Be Retained or Acquired During Activation of Genes Involved in the Epithelial to Mesenchymal Transition
description: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: GSM1636933: MCF7_Pol2_N20_ChIP_A Homo sapiens ChIP-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Cells were cross-linked with formaldehyde. Chromatin was sheared using Covaris S220 sonicator and immunoprecipitated on magnetic beads containing the antibody. Crosslinks were reversed by heating at 56'C overnight. The precipitated DNA was purified from protein by proteinase K and phenol/chloroform treatments, and used for preparation of a library using Illumina ChIP-seq library preparation kit All material was extracted from untreated MCF-7 cells Illumina TruSeq small RNA or ChIP-seq library preparation kits were used to prepare libraries

experiment_title: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: GSM1636930: MCF7_scRNA_1 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq

description: Illumina MiSeq sequencing: GSM1636930: MCF7_scRNA_1 Homo sapiens RNA-Seq
library_construction_protocol: Total RNA was extracted from nuclei using Trizol reagent. Short RNA (25-70nt size range) was selected using 15% urea-TBE PAGE. Capped RNA was selected using sequential enzymatic treatments using 5'-polyphosphatase, 5'-terminator exonuclease, alkaline phosphatase, and tobacco acid pyrophosphatase. Library was subsequently constructed using Illumina TruSeq SmallRNA kit All material was extracted from untreated MCF-7 cells Illumina TruSeq small RNA or ChIP-seq library preparation kits were used to prepare libraries
